title: The Live Composer WordPress plugin before 2.1.23 does not escape a pagination setting supplied through its…
description: The Live Composer WordPress plugin versions before 2.1.23 contain a vulnerability where a pagination setting supplied through post-listing module shortcodes is not properly escaped before being output in an HTML attribute. This flaw allows users with Contributor role or higher to execute Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks.
